To fully comply with Minecraft's EULA, then rewards must not affect game-play in any way - so the rewards must only be cosmetic. So if you award donators with extra set-homes, this no longer complys, as the EULA states that all players must have access to all of the game once you're on the server.

So rewards can only be non-gameplay affecting cosmetics like:

  • Custom Nicknames
  • Colours in chat
  • Commands that don't alter gameplay, like /hat, or /mobdisguise
  • Prefix or Suffix in chat
  • Effect Trails
  • Ability to disguise as mobs or players
  • Other cosmetic perks that don't enhance gameplay
